posts.title: Reading About Three Deadly Pursuits All at Once
posts.description: I was out of town for three days over the weekend, and then really busy on Monday so my two-a-day newspapers piled up. When I got a chance to go through them, I found three separate local stories about Ramsey County sheriffs pursuing a fleeing driver that led to one or more deaths. posts.title: Ho Hum, Not an Important Story
posts.description: I guess they're going to explode the 10,000 pounds of lead azide tomorrow morning, and that is the best-case scenario. The fact that this is not the top story on every national news outlet is a testament to the coastal bias of our media. Imagine if this was happening anywhere near New York, Washington, or a major California city. But a bunch of Iowa farmers and whoever happens to be too near them.
